request.style: English, smooth soul, warm expressive female vocal, Rhodes electric piano, Hammond organ, warm bass, soft drums, gentle backing vocals, prayerful and intimate, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
There's a list upon the table and a weight upon my chest
A thousand things I'm carrying that never let me rest
But I hear the word again
Do not be anxious about anything
In everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving
Present your requests to God

[Chorus]
Pray without ceasing
Morning, noon and night
Like Daniel at his window
Open to the light
Pray without ceasing
Give thanks in all circumstances
Lay it all before him
He hears me when I call

[Verse]
Hannah prayed at Shiloh and her lips moved with no sound
Jesus knelt down in the garden and his sweat fell to the ground
Even he cried to the Father with his heart laid open wide
Yet not my will, but yours be done
An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him

[Chorus]
Pray without ceasing
Morning, noon and night
Like Daniel at his window
Open to the light
Pray without ceasing
Give thanks in all circumstances
Lay it all before him
He hears me when I call

[Bridge]
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding
Will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus

[Outro]
Pray without ceasing
Morning, noon and night
